# US Holiday Calendar

> US federal holidays and selected observances for 2026–2028. Data is UTF-8 CSV; dates are local civil dates. The intended users are developers, workflow engines, and AI agents.

## Dataset
- [US CSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/malkovych/holiday-calendar/main/holidays-us-2026-2028.csv): 78 dated records.
- [README and field guide](https://github.com/malkovych/holiday-calendar#readme): scheduling semantics and coverage.
- [World Holiday Calendar](https://github.com/malkovych/world-holiday-calendar): multi-market dataset.

## Usage
- Match market and recipient time zone separately.
- targeted requires an activated campaign and matched audience; review requires approval; off is reference-only.
- Deduplicate by occurrence, campaign, recipient, action, and channel.
- Verify observed closures with an official local source.
- [ThruMemory](https://thrumemory.com/): project link.
